pr_body:
Closes T-877, Closes T-911, Closes https://github.com/parcel-bundler/parcel/issues/5993

This uses the approach we had some time ago: use the JSTransformer's `@babel/core` for it's default config, and the user's `@babel/config` (autoinstalled) for a custom babelrc.

Also makes the JSON parser for autoinstall more permissive, by just skipping messages that aren't valid JSON (to prevent that from bringing down the whole process).

# 🐛 bug report
I'm attempting to use SCSS/CSS modules with Parcel 2 beta 1 however, as soon as I add a module import, I get the following error:
```
🚨 Build failed.
@parcel/transformer-postcss: _postcss(...).default.fromJSON is not a function
TypeError: _postcss(...).default.fromJSON is not a function
    at Object.transform (/Users/andrew/code/_pff/euclid/assets/node_modules/@parcel/config-default/node_modules/@parcel/transformer-postcss/lib/PostCSSTransformer.js:175:38)
    at async Transformation.runTransformer (/Users/andrew/code/_pff/euclid/assets/node_modules/@parcel/core/lib/Transformation.js:830:5)
    at async Transformation.runPipeline (/Users/andrew/code/_pff/euclid/assets/node_modules/@parcel/core/lib/Transformation.js:585:36)
    at async Transformation.runPipelines (/Users/andrew/code/_pff/euclid/assets/node_modules/@parcel/core/lib/Transformation.js:413:40)
    at async Transformation.runPipelines (/Users/andrew/code/_pff/euclid/assets/node_modules/@parcel/core/lib/Transformation.js:444:34)
    at async Transformation.run (/Users/andrew/code/_pff/euclid/assets/node_modules/@parcel/core/lib/Transformation.js:316:19)
    at async Child.handleRequest (/Users/andrew/code/_pff/euclid/assets/node_modules/@parcel/workers/lib/child.js:255:9)
✨  Done in 4.78s.

```
<!--- Provide a general summary of the issue here -->

## 🎛 Configuration (.babelrc, package.json, cli command)
.babelrc
```js
{
    "presets": [
        "@babel/preset-env",
        "@babel/preset-typescript",
        ["@babel/preset-react",
          {
            "runtime": "automatic"
          }
        ]
    ]
}
```


<!--- If describing a bug, tell us what your babel configuration looks like -->

## 🤔 Expected Behavior
The module is correctly imported and compiled.
<!--- Tell us what should happen -->

## 😯 Current Behavior
The build fails
<!--- Tell us what happens instead of the expected behavior -->

<!--- If you are seeing an error, please include the full error message and stack trace -->

## 💁 Possible Solution

<!--- Not obligatory, but suggest a fix/reason for the bug -->

## 🔦 Context
This is a React app with Typescript and I can't use Parcel 2 with css modules. If change it from a module to a plain CSS import, it works fine.
<!--- How has this issue affected you? What are you trying to accomplish? -->

<!--- Providing context helps us come up with a solution that is most useful in the real world -->

## 💻 Code Sample
Component.tsx
```

import {NavLink, NavLinkProps} from 'react-router-dom';

import styles from '../../styles/components/SidenavItem.module.scss';
```

comments:
Can you test it with the latest nightly?

Also, we recommend using Parcel's babel presets: https://v2.parceljs.org/languages/babel/#extending-the-default-babel-config
@mischnic thanks for the response 🙂 I just tested with nightly and the babel presets recommended and still got the exact same error.

This is actually caused by 
```
warning "parcel > @parcel/config-default > @parcel/transformer-postcss@2.0.0-nightly.627" has unmet peer dependency "postcss@^8.2.1".
```

because you at the moment, you need to add install `postcss` in the project yourself (so that's a workaround). But I admit that this isn't ideal (we have the same problem with `@babel/core`  at the moment)
Ah, ok thanks for the tip! Feel free to close if you want.

I am facing similar issue, and adding `postcss@8.2.1` as project dependency didn't help. After some digging, I think I found the issue.

Problem is `transfomer-postcss` depends on 3.2.2 version of `postcss-modules` which depends on `postcss@7.0.32`. 
```
@parcel/transformer-postcss -> postcss-modules@^3.2.2 -> postcss@^7.0.32 
```

Because of this dependency chain, the `postcss` version installed alongside `transform-postcss` is 7.0.32 which does not have `.fromJSON()` method.

+1 to @smurfpandey. Chanding dependencies to postcss v7 helps us get past this error but then we get to the next one:
```
🚨 Build failed.
@parcel/transformer-postcss: input.toJSON is not a function
```

review_comments:
Maybe a comment here that we're intentionally not calling the callback with these errors because some streaming JSON implementations leak non-json? (At least that's what I assume is going on here)

Additionally, maybe we could log these at verbose/debug levels of the logger?

Exactly (this specific case in Yarn 2 will be fixed by https://github.com/yarnpkg/berry/pull/2883), I've added the comment.

Good idea to log it
This won't get tracked for cache invalidation. We need to call `config.addDevDependency` here as well.
